purpose: law research and inverse design, not tune all to pass
diagnostic_holdout: N19/N22 D1; retrospective known outcomes, not independent new blind test
inner: 3 family folds; train-only preprocessing; family-balanced fit/metrics
models: A same five-indicator Ridge without actual length
B five-indicator Ridge with actual length
C full complex-curve Ridge with actual length
new_HFSS: at most one N19 candidate only if grouped validation improves and in-domain candidate exists; 14 cores serial, hook, <=13 Analyze; old pause untouched
selection_gate: B family-balanced worstS11 MAE improves >=10% over A, B false pass count <=A; C independently must improve >=10% and no more false passes before curve inverse enabled
limitations: small selective data; folds are development not a new prospective test; no MLP/NN claim
